title: Database health before a major migration
description: Database state that blocks or slows the CMS migrations: large version and log history, orphan rows, obsolete editor aliases, and constraint problems. Checked read-only on the declared local copy.

impact.summary: The 7 to 8 content migration fails while obsolete editors are still in use.

sources.evidence: The migration will fail if you are still using obsolete properties

impact.summary: The block editor data migration can run long on large sites; cleaning up old content versions first makes it run faster.

sources.evidence: might require a long-running content migration
This will make the migration run faster

handling.option: Run read-only counts on the declared local copy (versions, logs, orphan rows, editor aliases) and record them as evidence
Use the documented content version cleanup settings, or an approved cleanup on the local copy with counts before and after

sources.evidence: Over time this amount of data can build and swallow up the capacity of your SQL Server

checks.text: Read-only health counts are recorded for the local copy before the database step
